messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH priority — metering mismatch detected between aggregator and billing-ledger. Token delta trending up for last 8m, ~+12% vs expected. 23 customers saw overage flags. Investigating. https://ops/internal/incidents/3167779999 :warning:
alex_oncall: acked — I'm on it. taking IC. starting triage, will gather scope. :eyes:
maya_sre: looking at kafka consumers + emitter traces. initial quick check: consumer-lag is fine for primary topic, but emitter-service shows repeated retries and partial acks to aggregator (possible dup suppressor misfire).
luis_billing: seeing anomalous shadow counts in recon table: latest snapshot shows sums higher than live by ~9k tokens in last 10m. customers impacted included a few high-volume dev accounts.
alex_oncall: @luis_billing can you list top 5 customers? we need to contact CS if visible impact.
luis_billing: top5: acct_neo, acct-sparrow, acct-orbit, acct-bento, acct-lumen. sending CSV to #support.
jen_pm: tagging customer-effect plan: if overage alerts are noisy we should pause automated billing alerts while we reconcile. what's ETA to pause?
sam_ops: can pause alerting in 60s, runbook step: `ops pause-alerts metering_overage` — need IC approval.
alex_oncall: do it. pause alerts now. :white_check_mark:
monitoring-bot: Action executed: alerts paused by sam_ops via ops control plane at 3167780105.
maya_sre: digging deeper — emitter logs show frequent 409s at /emit/batch with payloads ~partial-window. suspect race with window-rotation GC. sharing snippet:
```
2026-03-20T12:14:05Z emitter-01 WARN batch_commit failed status=409 window_id=20260320T1212 partial=true retries=3
2026-03-20T12:14:06Z emitter-01 INFO ack_sent tokens_emitted=4212 window_rot=20260320T1212
2026-03-20T12:14:07Z aggregator-03 ERROR apply_delta mismatch window=20260320T1212 expected=4120 got=8332
```
maya_sre: hypothesis: partial commits double-counted in ledger replay path when retry + gc overlap.
alex_oncall: plan: 1) pause alerts (done) 2) run targeted reconcile for affected windows 3) put emitter into single-writer mode and disable auto-retry for 30m 4) notify customers if recon fails. assign roles.
maya_sre: I'll run the reconcile job: `billing-reconcile --from 2026-03-20T12:10 --to 2026-03-20T12:20 --mode=dry-run` to estimate delta, then apply. will report back within 20m.
sam_ops: setting emitter to single-writer now: `svcctl scale emitter-service --replicas 1 --mode=maintenance` — rolling update in progress.
monitoring-bot: emitter-service rolling to 1 replica triggered by sam_ops at 3167780322. health checks in progress.
luis_billing: recon dry-run shows +8,940 tokens across top5. projected billing impact ~ $12.8 for those customers (noise).
jen_pm: low dollar impact but noisy alerts are bad. we'll send a short note to affected customers after we reconcile. drafting now.
alex_oncall: good. if reconcile reduces delta to <1% we close P1 to P3. if not, escalate to infra.
maya_sre: reconcile apply started. running with id=rc-3167779999-1. progress ~15%.
monitoring-bot: reconcile job rc-3167779999-1 completed at 3167781180. result: resolved delta, ledger aligned. no further overage flags generated.
alex_oncall: closing mitigation: alerts remain paused for 10m to ensure stability, then resume. filing incident ticket and postmortem. assigning postmortem owner @maya_sre.
jen_pm: I'll coordinate customer comms for the 23 customers — short apology + confirmation no charge for spurious overage alerts.
luis_billing: will run final audit and issue credits if any were applied automatically.
maya_sre: postmortem checklist: investigate emitter retry + gc window interaction, add stricter idempotency on commit path, add better metrics for partial commits.
alex_oncall: thx team. IC handing back to normal ops. :hands_together:
summary: Metering pipeline emitted duplicate/partial windows due to emitter retries overlapping window GC. Alerts paused, emitter single-writer mode, reconcile job fixed ledger. 23 customers briefly flagged; customer comms and credits planned.
